homePageConfig.tagline: Ethical Loan Recovery & Borrower Resolution Advisory
homePageConfig.heroHeadline: Fair, Transparent Loan Recovery & Financial Guidance
homePageConfig.heroSubheadline: We partner with lending institutions and borrowers to resolve overdue accounts respectfully—providing clear repayment pathways and practical education on Payday Loans and Micro Loans.
homePageConfig.aboutDescription: AppAssistServices is an independent loan recovery and receivables advisory firm dedicated to structured, dignity-first resolution. Rather than automated pressure, our case specialists help borrowers understand loan obligations, avoid compounding late fees, and close overdue accounts with documented clarity.
homePageConfig.paydayLoansSummary: Payday loans are short-term, unsecured cash advances designed to bridge urgent expenses until a borrower’s next salary cycle. Knowing the true cost and repayment window prevents rollover debt.
paydayLoansPoints: Short tenure: Typically due in full on your next salary date (7 to 45 days).
Higher effective APR: Convenience fees and daily penal charges add up rapidly if overdue.
Single-cycle purpose: Best reserved for genuine emergencies rather than recurring monthly bills.
Early resolution matters: Contacting your recovery desk early helps waive penalties and protect your credit bureau record.
homePageConfig.microLoansSummary: Micro loans provide small-ticket credit—often between ₹2,000 and ₹1,00,000—for individuals, gig workers, and small shopkeepers who need accessible working capital or personal support.
microLoansPoints: Flexible EMIs: Structured in weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly installments tailored to cash flow.
Minimal collateral: Approved primarily on KYC, income consistency, and repayment track record.
Credit-building impact: Timely closure boosts creditworthiness and unlocks lower-cost formal credit.
Restructuring options: Genuine hardship cases can request revised schedules or One-Time Settlement (OTS) terms.
homePageConfig.recoveryTitle: How Our Loan Recovery Process Works
homePageConfig.recoverySubtitle: Every overdue account is handled through a documented, RBI-aligned communication and resolution framework.

recoverySteps.title: 1. Account Review & Clear Notice
recoverySteps.description: We verify principal, accrued interest, and valid waivers with the lending partner before issuing a clear statement of dues.

recoverySteps.title: 2. Consultative Resolution Options
recoverySteps.description: Assigned recovery coordinators work with borrowers to arrange full closure, partial extensions, or approved settlement schedules.

recoverySteps.title: 3. Instant Closure & NOC Records
recoverySteps.description: Once resolved, account status updates are logged promptly so borrowers receive closure confirmation and credit bureau updates.

homePageConfig.complianceNotice: Compliance Commitment: AppAssistServices strictly follows fair debt collection practices. We never endorse harassment, unauthorized contact with third parties, or hidden charges. Always verify official notices through our listed support desk.
homePageConfig.officeAddress: Suite 402, Trade Tower B, Financial District, Mumbai 400051

noticeTemplates.description: Formal recovery notice warning of CIBIL default and field agent visits.
noticeTemplates.content:
{{customer.name}},

To stop the field agents and clear your record, pay your ONE-TIME SETTLEMENT of INR {{payment.amount}}/- immediately using this link:
👉 {{payment.link}}

Your {{brand.name}} account (Order NO: {{payment.loan_order_number}}) is severely overdue. We have approved a final settlement amount of INR {{payment.amount}}/- for today only.

If this settlement is not cleared in the next 1 hour, the offer will be cancelled and the following actions will begin:

CIBIL Defaulter Entry: Your PAN ({{customer.pan}}) and registered details will be permanently reported as a defaulter, blocking your access to any future loans or credit cards.
Field Recovery Visit: Our collection agents will be dispatched directly to your registered home address for physical cash collection of the full original penalty amount.

Clear your settlement dues right now to permanently close this account and receive your NOC.

Recovery Department
{{brand.name}} Financial Services
